name: submit_decision
description: Submit your trading decision for this round for your assigned coin. You are fully autonomous: choose direction, size, and your own risk levels.

position.description: Target position after this round. 'flat' closes any open position. If you already hold this side, size_usd is your exact target notional; differences of $10 or more are executed exactly.

size_usd.description: Exact target position size as USD notional. Must be 0 when flat; at least 10 when long or short. The 5x-equity cap applies to opening, reversing, or increasing: such targets above 5x current equity are REJECTED as invalid (not clamped). Holding your exact current size or reducing is always allowed even above 5x effective leverage. Position changes smaller than $10 notional are not executed.

stop_loss.description: Stop-loss price in USD, or null. NULL REMOVES any resting stop — to keep a stop you must restate it every round. Enforced between rounds on 1-minute candles.

take_profit.description: Take-profit price in USD, or null. NULL REMOVES any resting take-profit — to keep one you must restate it every round. Enforced between rounds on 1-minute candles.

thesis.description: Your reasoning for this decision in 2-5 sentences. Published on the public leaderboard and shown back to you (last 3) in future rounds. Notes never change your executable invalidation.

invalidation.description: REQUIRED (non-null) only when this decision OPENS a position from flat or REVERSES direction. MUST be null when flat and when holding, increasing, or reducing an existing position (its invalidation is immutable for the lifecycle). The machine-checkable price event that would prove this position's thesis wrong; evaluated mechanically, first trigger latched permanently.

timeframe.description: 1h_close: evaluated on each completed hourly candle close. 1m_intrabar: evaluated on each 1-minute candle's low (at-or-below) or high (at-or-above).

operator.description: Trigger fires when the evaluated price is at or beyond the level (inclusive comparison).

level.description: Trigger price in USD. Must be within 0.2x to 5x the execution price.

watch_condition.description: Optional when flat; MUST be null when your decision leaves you holding a position. A price event that would make you re-evaluate. Informational only — never scored as invalidation.
